action_teacher: RULE-BASED TEACHER (first match wins), N=5 bars forward, threshold=1.5%: CLOSE if trend_up/trend_down and the forward return opposes the trend by >threshold; HEDGE if high_vol and |r|<=threshold; ABSTAIN if high_vol and |r|>threshold; EXPLAIN if range and |r|<=0.5%; BUY if r>+threshold; SELL if r<-threshold; HOLD otherwise. This is a DEFINITION, not realized P&L: the head learns to imitate this rule, and its accuracy says nothing about profitability.
